answer: Each agent registers a ledge witness log anchoring its identity to the epoch's Merkle root; the log is finalized after 4 independent peer attestations, each staking 50 POA for 5 epochs. An attacker forging N clones must pass N independent karst challenges, each requiring a distinct cryptographic proof; the joint success probability decays exponentially, so marginal cost per fake identity rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a island receipt each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real outages to recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
